title: Durable vs transient
rule: A toast confirms the current action; notification center stores durable business events. A toast alone must not represent a failure requiring later action.

title: Recipient scope
rule: Every notification resolves explicit user recipients within one tenant based on role, ownership, subscription and preferences.

title: Authorization
rule: Opening a notification deep link rechecks current permission; payload must not reveal data the user can no longer access.

title: Read state
rule: Unread/read is stored per user and synchronized across devices; marking one item or all items is idempotent.

title: Action state
rule: Actionable notifications may be open, resolved or expired independently of read state.

title: Deduplication
rule: The same source event and recipient creates at most one notification; repeated provider webhooks cannot inflate unread count.

title: Severity
rule: Severity is info, success, warning or critical and controls icon/color only; it does not replace event type.

title: Preferences
rule: Users may mute optional event categories; security, permission and critical delivery failures cannot be muted unless policy allows.

title: Channels
rule: MVP supports in-app; email channel is opt-in per event policy. Channel failure does not roll back the underlying business transaction.

title: Deep link
rule: Each actionable notification has a stable route and resource ID; invalid/deleted targets show a safe explanatory state.

title: Batching
rule: High-volume similar events are grouped into one summary notification within a configured window.

title: Offline recovery
rule: After reconnect/login, the unread API is authoritative and fills events missed by the socket connection.

title: Retention
rule: Notification retention and PII minimization are configurable; deletion of notification does not delete audit events.

title: Trigger catalog
rule: Campaign completion/failure, schedule dispatch/miss, import/bulk completion, sender failure and quota thresholds have explicit trigger definitions.

title: Localization
rule: Store message key and structured parameters, not only rendered text, so UI can render the user's locale.

title: Observability
rule: Notification creation, socket delivery, channel attempt and read action emit metrics with notification/event IDs but no unmasked PII.
